claim.quote: Thus a 90% confidence level upper limit on Spin-Dependent WIMP-proton cross section of 50 pb for a WIMP mass of 100 GeV/c2 was derived. This limit is the most stringent yet obtained from direction-sensitive dark matter search experiments.

key_value.note: 90% CL spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit at 100 GeV/c^2.
key_value.quote: of 50 pb for a WIMP mass of 100 GeV/c2

name: Direction-sensitive dark matter search with a low-background gaseous detector NEWAGE-0.3b''

summary.plain: With a new low-radioactivity readout, NEWAGE took 107.6 days of data in 2018 in the Kamioka mine and found no forward-backward asymmetry. The spin-dependent limit of 50 pb at 100 GeV/c^2 was the best from any direction-sensitive experiment.
summary.technical: NEWAGE-0.3b'' with the low-alpha mu-PIC, 2018, 107.6 live days = 1.1 kg d: two events in 50-60 keV against 2.5 expected background; no significant forward-backward asymmetry; 90% CL spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit 50 pb at 100 GeV/c^2.

title: Direction-sensitive dark matter search with a low-background gaseous detector NEWAGE-0.3b''
why_it_matters: The abstract calls it the most stringent limit yet from direction-sensitive searches (as of 2021).
